name: sift
title: Sift
description: Convert any file on your Mac into clean, token-lean Markdown for Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT. Strips PDF bloat, structures slide decks by slide, bulk-converts folders, and fetches YouTube transcripts. Runs locally — no uploads, no API keys.
author: njoshi

commands.name: convert
commands.title: Convert to Markdown
commands.subtitle: Convert files for LLMs
commands.description: Search any file on your Mac by name (or its folder) and sift it into clean Markdown.

commands.name: convert-selected
commands.title: Convert Selected File in Finder
commands.subtitle: Convert files for LLMs
commands.description: Convert the file(s) currently selected in Finder to Markdown — no typing.

commands.name: convert-latest
commands.title: Convert Latest Download
commands.subtitle: Convert files for LLMs
commands.description: Convert the most recently modified file in ~/Downloads to Markdown.

commands.name: convert-youtube
commands.title: Convert YouTube URL from Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Convert files for LLMs
commands.description: Read a YouTube URL from the clipboard, fetch its captions via yt-dlp, and save a clean Markdown transcript.

preferences.name: markitdownPath
preferences.title: MarkItDown Binary Path
preferences.description: Path to the markitdown executable. Leave blank to auto-detect (~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin).

preferences.name: outputLocation
preferences.title: Output Location
preferences.description: Where to save the converted Markdown.

preferences.name: customOutputFolder
preferences.title: Custom Output Folder
preferences.description: Used when Output Location is set to 'Custom folder'.

preferences.name: openAfterConvert
preferences.title: After Conversion
preferences.label: Open the resulting .md file
preferences.description: When enabled, opens the converted Markdown file in your default app.

preferences.name: copyToClipboard
preferences.title: Clipboard
preferences.label: Also copy the Markdown to the clipboard
preferences.description: When enabled, copies the converted Markdown content to your clipboard after each conversion.

preferences.name: addFrontmatter
preferences.title: Frontmatter
preferences.label: Prepend YAML frontmatter to the output
preferences.description: When enabled, adds a YAML frontmatter block with source path, timestamp, and conversion mode to every Markdown output.
